svg.aria-label: Sequence for a resolution request: the treasurer uploads the signed resolution and file_resolution saves it as pending with no amount; SAS sees it in Approvals, types the amount written in the resolution, and review_resolution checks the savings and writes a release from saved to cash. After the activity the treasurer liquidates with the activity name, receipt items and files; submit_resolution_liquidation saves it; SAS approves and review_resolution_liquidation writes the expense and returns the unspent money to savings; the treasurer is notified at each decision.
svg.text: saved with SAS → cash on hand
